notes.title: A new free to play game by AinkOink - Don’t Let Me Fade
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029740/507e63a58e3552f0f61e8491dd4bf885057fe554.jpg"][/img]Don’t Let Me Fade is now live on Steam - and it’s free to play! 🎮[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837970/Dont_Let_Me_Fade/"][/dynamiclink] Created in just 48 hours during a GG-jam 2025, this tiny narrative game quickly made an impact on itch.io - and now it's reaching a broader audience✨    
It’s short. It’s quiet. But it lingers.  And yes - there’s the only one Steam achievement waiting at the end.   If you enjoy the mood, you can support me by getting the original soundtrack, featuring two tracks made during the jam and a special bonus piece from Mirrorandum.

Take a moment - and don’t let this fade![/p]

notes.title: Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025 with FlopHop
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029740/246baf3a21a4e45255d2ce16c6a4eee1b9c16a1d.png[/img]
Heading to [url=https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/en/]Tokyo for the Indie Games Summit[/url] to present Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop! I’m beyond excited that it was selected for the event. This major event is happening on March 8–9, and I’m honored to be part of it. I’ll have my very own FlopHop booth - number RO-3a - at the Kichijoji Tokyu REI Hotel. You’ll be able to play the game, chat with me, and even grab some merch - including handmade items! It promises to be an exciting event, and I’ll definitely dedicate a separate gamedev diary entry to share all about it.

Mata ne!

notes.title: From The Countdown to Demo – FlopHop Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The Countdown was just a small prequel to the main game of the Bunniverse [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3013500/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop/]Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop[/url] is set to release in 2025... But you can play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/]the DEMO[/url] now! FlopHop is taking part in Steam Next Fest this week, so if you haven’t had a chance to try the demo yet, now is the perfect time!

If the game has touched your heart, you can support its development by purchasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148460/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo_Soundtrack/]the FlopHop Soundtrack Album[/url], which features the music from the demo.

Hoppy Steam Next Fest to everybunn!

notes.content:

The Bunny Space Odyssey: The Countdown collection will be discounted for two weeks: 
[list]

[/list]

I also want to announce the release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/?beta=0]Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop Demo[/url]! This is the main game of the series - an adventure platformer that develops the main story of the Bunniverse. It's out now and it will take part in the Steam Next Fest soon. 

The FlopHop Demo is giving you a sneak peek into the whimsical yet mysterious journey of Ponchee, a curious bunny who awakens on the strange, uninhabited planet of FlopHop. Stranded with no memories of her past, Ponchee's only companion is her intelligent spacesuit, Usagi-01, which guides her through the challenges ahead, unraveling the story of her past, the fate of her home, and her mission on this barren world.
